```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(googlesheets4)
library(scales)
library(here)

source(here::here("R", "config.R"))
```

## Load & Prepare Data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

lindy_pairs <- read_sheet(
  GOOGLE_SHEETS$registrations_2026,
  sheet = "lindy_pairs_locked"
)

LINDY_QUOTAS <- tibble(
  level = c("intermediate", "int-advanced", "advanced"),
  quota = c(
    GROUP_CAPACITIES$intermediate,
    GROUP_CAPACITIES$intermediate_advanced,
    GROUP_CAPACITIES$advanced
  )
)

if (!"quota" %in% names(lindy_pairs)) {
  lindy_pairs <- lindy_pairs |>
    left_join(LINDY_QUOTAS, by = "level")
}

# ── Festival palette ──
col_empty  <- "#E26941"   # orange (spots left)
col_filled <- "#0D3447"   # dark navy (registered)
col_bg     <- "#FFE17B"   # golden yellow (background)
col_accent <- "#4E332E"   # dark brown

# ── Counts per level + role ──
reg_counts <- lindy_pairs |>
  group_by(level) |>
  summarise(
    Leaders   = sum(!is.na(email_leader)),
    Followers = sum(!is.na(email_follower)),
    quota     = first(quota),
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(Leaders, Followers),
    names_to  = "role",
    values_to = "registered"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    remaining = pmax(quota - registered, 0),
    level     = factor(
      level,
      levels = c("intermediate", "int-advanced", "advanced"),
      labels = c("Intermediate", "Int-Advanced", "Advanced")
    ),
    pct   = registered / quota,
    label = paste0(registered, " / ", quota)
  )

# ── Long format for stacked bars ──
bar_data <- reg_counts |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(registered, remaining),
    names_to  = "status",
    values_to = "count"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    status = factor(
      status,
      levels = c("remaining", "registered"),
      labels = c("Spots left", "Registered")
    )
  )
```

## Overview — All Levels

```{r}
#| label: overview-plot
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 6.5

ggplot(bar_data, aes(x = role, y = count, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, colour = col_filled, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(
    data    = reg_counts,
    aes(x = role, y = registered / 2,
        label = percent(pct, accuracy = 1), fill = NULL),
    colour  = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data    = reg_counts,
    aes(x = role, y = quota, label = label, fill = NULL),
    vjust   = -0.6, colour = col_filled, fontface = "bold", size = 4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ level, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Registered" = col_filled, "Spots left" = col_empty),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title    = "Midnight Sun Swing 2026",
    subtitle = "Leaders & Followers per Level (pair quota)",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    text             = element_text(family = "sans"),
    plot.title       = element_text(colour = col_filled, face = "bold",
                                    size = 22, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(colour = col_filled, size = 13,
                                    hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 12)),
    strip.text       = element_text(colour = col_filled, face = "bold", size = 15),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = col_empty, colour = NA),
    axis.text.y      = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks       = element_blank(),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "top",
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = col_bg, colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = col_bg, colour = NA),
    plot.margin      = margin(15, 15, 10, 15)
  )
```

## Instagram Chart — All Levels

```{r}
#| label: instagram-plot
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 7.5

ig_dir <- here::here("01_registration", "instagram")
dir.create(ig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

ig_plot <- ggplot(bar_data, aes(x = level, y = count, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, colour = col_filled, linewidth = 0.4) +
  # Percentage inside the registered portion
  geom_text(
    data   = reg_counts,
    aes(x = level, y = registered / 2,
        label = percent(pct, accuracy = 1), fill = NULL),
    colour = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 5.5
  ) +
  # "n / quota" to the right of each bar
  geom_text(
    data  = reg_counts,
    aes(x = level, y = quota, label = label, fill = NULL),
    hjust = -0.15, colour = col_filled, fontface = "bold", size = 4.5
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  facet_wrap(~ role, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Registered" = col_filled, "Spots left" = col_empty)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.32))) +
  labs(
    title   = "Midnight Sun Swing 2026",
    caption = "@midnightsun_swing",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    text             = element_text(family = "sans"),
    plot.title       = element_text(colour = col_filled, face = "bold",
                                    size = 26, hjust = 0.5,
                                    margin = margin(b = 12)),
    plot.caption     = element_text(colour = col_accent, size = 11,
                                    hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    strip.text       = element_text(colour = col_filled, face = "bold", size = 18),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = col_empty, colour = NA),
    axis.text.x      = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(colour = col_filled, face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.ticks       = element_blank(),
    panel.grid       = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "none",
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = col_bg, colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = col_bg, colour = NA),
    plot.margin      = margin(20, 40, 15, 20)
  )

# Save 1080 × 1350 px (4:5 Instagram portrait)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(ig_dir, "all_levels_ig.png"),
  plot     = ig_plot,
  width = 6, height = 7.5, dpi = 180, bg = col_bg
)

ig_plot
```
